purpose: Confirm details; teach セミナー/日時/メイン/地区/時点/できるだけ/もともと/多少

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: セミナーの受付、私が手伝います。
lines.en: I’ll help with the seminar reception.
lines.style: eager helper volunteering cheerfully, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 助かる。日時はチラシに大きく載せてね。
lines.en: Thanks. Put the date and time big on the flyer.
lines.style: grateful organizer giving direction, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイン会場の地図も入れますか？
lines.en: Shall I include a map of the main venue?
lines.style: thoughtful helper anticipating needs, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お願い。地区の住民にも配りたいの。
lines.en: Please. I want to hand it out to the district’s residents.
lines.style: organizer expanding the outreach, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 現時点で、参加者は何人ですか？
lines.en: How many attendees as of now?
lines.style: helper checking the count, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: できるだけ多く集めたいけど、今は五十人ほど。
lines.en: I want as many as possible, but it’s about fifty now.
lines.style: organizer sharing the honest number, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: もともと小さく始める予定でしたよね。
lines.en: We originally planned to start small, right?
lines.style: helper recalling the plan, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ええ、多少増えても対応できます。
lines.en: Yes, we can handle it growing a little.
lines.style: organizer staying flexible, voice clear and distinctly their own
